summary: Iteration 3 tested the TWO new features: (1) Send-to-Contacts share sheet and (2) Emoji illustrations on dictionary words + learn quiz. Backend: 7/7 new pytest tests PASS in test_iter3_share_emoji.py (ES dictionary=65 items = 27 letters + 38 words; EN=64 = 26+38; every kind=word has non-empty emoji, kind=letter has no emoji; IDs unique; 'Agua'->💧, 'Water', 'Familia', 'Doctor' present; learn/today word items propagate emoji field; no _id leaks). Frontend (mobile 390x844 web): Full auth flow works (phone-input+send-otp-button, otp-0..5=123456, name-input+continue-btn=María López, skip-btn). Dictionary tab: kind-word shows 38 emoji-lsm-w-* tiles (no photo); card-lsm-w-17 opens modal with title 'Agua' and large 💧; modal-close works. Learn tab: start-lesson works, quiz-emoji visible for word questions (all 5 questions in this run happened to be words per today's seed). Translator sharing works end-to-end: mode-voice+text-input 'Nos vemos mañana'+send-btn creates bubble with share-<id>; tapping opens contact-picker+manual-entry; manual-continue aria-disabled=true when empty and 5 digits; clicking it while short does NOT open send-options; typing '+52 55 1234 5678' enables it; send-options shows recipient row + preview containing 'Nos vemos mañana' + '1234', plus send-whatsapp, send-sms, change-contact. change-contact returns to manual-entry. send-whatsapp opens a popup to wa.me/525512345678?text=Nos+vemos+ma%C3%B1ana (WhatsApp redirects popup to api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=525512345678&text=Nos+vemos+ma%C3%B1ana... — correct behavior; digits and message intact) and the sheet closes. contact-picker-close ✕ dismisses the sheet. Regression: favorites-row+export-pdf still shown when messages exist, ⭐ still saves fav-chip. No JS/red-screen errors. No deprecated packages (expo-contacts, expo-haptics, expo-audio all current).
critical_code_review_comments: ContactPicker.tsx handles the permission contract correctly: check→request→canAskAgain→Open Settings (uses Linking.openSettings). Includes 'blocked' branch and manual entry fallback for both denied and unsupported/web. Cannot verify native contact list on web (expected).
openWhatsApp uses digitsOnly() so '+52 55 1234 5678' becomes 525512345678 in wa.me URL — correct. openSms uses phone.replace(/[^\d+]/g, '') and platform-specific separator (?/&) — correct.
translator.tsx is now 651+ lines. Consider extracting the share/contacts UI wiring; still under 700 but growing.
Backend has no server-side changes for the share feature — it's client-only via Linking. Nothing to test on the API side for sharing. Correct architecture.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 new-feature tests pass; 14/14 previous tests still valid)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows: dictionary emoji, word detail modal, learn quiz-emoji, share sheet (manual entry, disable-until-7-digits, send-options preview, change-contact, contact-picker-close, WhatsApp popup open, sheet auto-close), favorites/export-pdf regression.

seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates a fresh user via a unique phone number based on timestamp. Frontend runs used phones 5559997766/5559997755 with country +52.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tab bar items in (tabs)/_layout.tsx do NOT have testIDs — click by emoji text ('💬','📖','🎓','👤') last-occurrence, or by role. Login uses testIDs phone-input, send-otp-button, otp-0..5, name-input, continue-btn, skip-btn. Share flow lives entirely in ContactPicker.tsx; wa.me URL redirects to api.whatsapp.com — that's expected and the digits/text are preserved. Native contacts permission cannot be tested on web (Platform.OS==='web' → perm='unsupported' → manual entry only). Backend dictionary seed uses upsert on startup, so re-seed on backend restart is idempotent.
